## How to add a comment to an IP address on VirusTotal

### 1. Prepare your request

**Endpoint**

```
POST https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/192.168.1.1/comments
```

**Headers**

| Header | Value |
|--------|-------|
| `x-apikey` | `ABC321` |
| `Content-Type` | `application/json` |

**Body**

```json
{
  "type": "comment",
  "attributes": {
    "text": "Confirmed #malware"
  }
}
```

### 2. Send the request

You can use `curl`, Postman, or any HTTP client library in your preferred language.  
Example with `curl`:

```bash
curl -X POST "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/192.168.1.1/comments" \
     -H "x-apikey: ABC321" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"type":"comment","attributes":{"text":"Confirmed #malware"}}'
```

### 3. Handle the response

A successful request will return a `201 Created` status code and a JSON body containing the newly created comment’s ID and other metadata. If there’s an error (e.g., invalid API key, rate limit exceeded), you’ll receive an appropriate error code and message.

---

### Quick sanity check

If you want to verify that the comment was added, you can retrieve the comments for that IP:

```
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/192.168.1.1/comments
```

Again, include the same `x-apikey` header.
